basis: Source-first comparison, without design skills or ponytail; imagegen used only for image production.
sharedPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE high-fidelity flat design-system specimen board for dg-design, applying the researched flex fx/fxm product grammar. This is an original visual proposal, not existing shipped DDS or official flex tokens.
Canvas: large landscape 4:3, aim 2000x1500. Clean nearly white specimen background #F7F8FA, white UI surfaces, crisp dark text #262A2D, readable supporting text #626B76, fine borders #E1E5EB. Primary action BLUE #155EEF, pale blue #EDF3FF; green only meaningful success. System sans with excellent Korean, regular/bold, realistic body14–16px-equivalent and clear component labels. Modest corner radii: fields around6–8 desktop or16 mobile; buttons8 or12; panels12–16. These are visual proportions, no numeric token annotations. Soft shadows only under floating UI. Keep 1px floating-panel edge. Default, hover, focus and selected must be distinct. No bright green primary actions or gradients, no glass/3D/perspective, no device mockups, decorative charts or giant icons. UI copy in Korean exactly as given; component names in English exactly as given.
Layout: small top-left "dg-design / flex study", prominent board title specified below, short subtitle "원문 우선 적용안". Use clearly separated numbered component zones with generous outer margins; prioritize readable UI over annotation. Do not surround every zone with a card. Draw real UI content, not placeholder bars, except actual Skeleton examples. No component can be omitted or replaced by a description. One coherent visual language across zones. Tiny footer "Design proposal · 2026". No claim of accessibility or implementation validation.
Reasoning direction: desktop supports composing meaningful objects, values and actions; mobile uses consistent precomposed field/row patterns. Retain input labels, object context and clear action hierarchy. Sample data is fictional.

boards.title: 01 · Controls
boards.body:
Five clearly labeled zones. Top full-width zone "Button": hierarchy row blue "저장", neutral weak "취소", ghost "더 보기", critical "삭제"; below it three small state examples "포커스" (thin separated blue ring), "처리 중" (same-width blue button with white spinner), "비활성" (gray). No outline variant.
Lower area is a two-column, two-row layout:
"Checkbox": three labeled boxes "기본" empty, "선택" blue with white check, "일부 선택" blue with white horizontal dash. Include one small disabled example. Modest 16/20px-equivalent square marks, no circular checks.
"RadioGroup": settings title "알림 주기". Three wide pale-neutral rows: "실시간" selected with a dark slate circular radio, "하루 한 번" unselected, "받지 않음" unselected. A small segmented sample below "목록 / 보드", first segment active on white. Emphasize neutral selection, blue reserved for action.
"Switch": two settings rows with right-aligned switches, "알림 받기" blue/on, "소리 재생" gray/off; small helper "설정은 즉시 반영됩니다." Maintain clear thumb positions.
"Slider": heading "미리보기 크기", value "100%" right. Thin neutral track with blue active segment and a circular thumb at center. Small three-value labels "80%", "100%", "120%". Show a compact sample text "미리보기" underneath to connect value and result. Do not depict made-up extra state controls.

boards.title: 02 · Fields
boards.body:
Four spacious component zones in a 2x2 layout, equal prominence.
"Field": show complete anatomy by rendering a label "이메일", actual input with "name@example.com", supporting sentence "업무용 이메일을 입력하세요." Next to it or below a smaller invalid example with label "이메일", entered value "name", red boundary and message "이메일 형식을 확인하세요." This zone is the label/control/helper/error composition, not just a text input.
"TextField": box and line are equal first-class styles. Show a mobile-style soft-gray rounded box with small internal label "제목" and value "디자인 시스템 기록"; below show a line-only field with label "한 줄 소개" and value "만들고 기록합니다". Add a compact search field with magnifier and placeholder "검색". Keep internal label readable, blue focused edge on one example only.
"TextArea": a box-style multi-line field with internal label "내용", value "컴포넌트의 표현과 동작을\n함께 정리합니다." Below it a line-style multiline counterpart with the same role and no enclosing rectangle. Small footer "최대 200자" rather than a numeric character count that may be wrong. Helpers outside the box.
"FileInput": restrained light-neutral upload area with small upload icon, "파일을 선택하세요", secondary text "또는 여기에 놓으세요", and neutral button "파일 선택". Below a single attachment row: document icon, "design-notes.pdf", "240 KB", small remove x. One small error line "파일 형식을 확인하세요." with a clear invalid exemplar label. No photos. Emphasize usable field compositions over decorative forms.

boards.title: 03 · Selection
boards.body:
Three large vertical zones with ample width.
"Select": render three entry forms along the top: an ordinary field labeled "담당자" with value "김민서", a small text Button "담당자 선택", and a contextual avatar chip "김민서". Under them one open single-select panel containing search "이름으로 검색", option "김민서" with a simple blue CHECK ONLY, option "박지훈" with pale gray hover but NO check, option "이서연" ordinary. Each row may include a small initials avatar and smaller team descriptor "디자인", "개발", "제품". Do not use square checkbox marks here. Trigger value can be simple while open options show richer information.
"MultiSelect": field/chips "김민서" and "박지훈", one open panel with search, header "2명 선택" and "전체 해제". Exactly THREE options: 김민서 checked square, 박지훈 checked square, 이서연 empty square. Use blue checkbox squares. Footer helper "검색해도 선택은 유지됩니다." No extra selected values and no inconsistent counts.
"DatePicker": demonstrate DateRangePicker within this family. Two value fields "시작일 10월 12일" and "종료일 10월 14일". A legible calendar titled "2026년 10월", weekdays "일 월 화 수 목 금 토". Correct complete grid: first row blank blank blank blank 1 2 3; next 4 5 6 7 8 9 10; next 11 12 13 14 15 16 17; next 18 19 20 21 22 23 24; last 25 26 27 28 29 30 31. Blue-filled endpoints12 and14, pale continuous fill on13. Clear blue outline for keyboard focus on another day only if it doesn't resemble a selected range. Footer "취소" and blue "적용". Small caption "같은 달력 · 팝오버 / 시트 / 인라인". Keep calendar readable; no miniature phone.

boards.title: 04 · Navigation & Menus
boards.body:
Five named zones. Top is a product-header specimen split into clearly labeled "Breadcrumb" and "Tabs". Breadcrumb exact "Studio / 디자인 / 컴포넌트" with current last item dark and earlier links muted. Tabs directly below a small page title "컴포넌트": "전체", "입력", "탐색"; "입력" selected with blue underline, separate subtle hover on "탐색". Add a quiet search icon and ONE blue "새 항목" page-header CTA.
Middle left large "DropdownMenu": open menu with group label "문서 작업"; items "이름 변경" with shortcut, "다른 위치로 이동" with right chevron and a visible small submenu containing "작업실", "보관함"; a divider; a check/toggle-like setting row "알림 받기"; separate critical "삭제". At bottom a bounded helper area "선택한 문서에 적용됩니다." Keep menu contents accessible-looking and not nested arbitrary buttons.
Middle right large "ContextMenu": show a document row "디자인 가이드" with an explicit trailing more button, a context menu anchored beside it: "열기", "링크 복사", divider, red "삭제". Tiny caption "우클릭과 더보기에서 같은 행동". Clear visual relation but no desktop cursor graphic necessary.
Bottom full-width small "Pagination": "이전", "1", "2", "3", "…", "12", "다음". Page2 selected with a restrained neutral surface and bold number, other pages quiet. No saturated-blue boxes around every nav control.

boards.title: 05 · Structure
boards.body:
Four named zones with real content.
"Accordion": a single column of three group headers. "기본 정보" expanded with title/description and content rows "이름 김민서", "소속 디자인"; "추가 정보" collapsed; "변경 이력" collapsed. "Collapsible": two side-by-side snapshots of the same smaller disclosure. "Separator": show a horizontal divider between two property rows "작성자 김민서" and "공개 범위 전체 공개"; nearby a short inline toolbar "수정 | 복제 | 더보기" using two vertical 1px separators. This is separator usage, not decorative ruled paper. Keep every English zone title clear and legible.

boards.title: 08 · Data & Identity
boards.body:
Five labeled zones. Top two large side-by-side tables.
"Table": plain semantic table, columns "문서", "상태", "작성자". Three rows: "디자인 기록 | 초안 | 김민서"; "컴포넌트 가이드 | 발행됨 | 박지훈"; "인터페이스 노트 | 검토 중 | 이서연". Thin horizontal dividers, calm header, no checkbox, no full-grid vertical borders. Third row may have subtle hover.
"DataTable": same three records but with a small toolbar search "문서 검색", filter chip "상태: 전체", and "1개 선택". Header has sortable document column and empty selection checkbox. Exactly one selected row, the FIRST, with blue checked square plus pale selected background; rows two/three unchecked. No extra checked boxes. Small bottom pagination "1 / 1". Render numeric/sort cues precisely; this is the richer data table, visibly distinct from Table.
Bottom three compact zones:
"Avatar": four circle initials avatars at24/36/48/64-like relative sizes, "김", "박", "이", "도"; one neutral fallback and one small status-dot example. No real people photos.
"Badge": small noninteractive labels "초안" neutral weak, "발행됨" positive weak, "검토 중" informative weak, "오류" critical weak. No remove x or chevron on status badges.
"NotificationBadge": three contexts: bell with tiny dot, inbox with count "3", another with "12"; counts visually attached to the parent icon. Label dot/count distinction subtly. Same measured component scale as the rest of the series.

boards.title: 09 · Feedback
boards.body:
Four balanced labeled zones. No oversized illustrations.
"Alert": persistent inline banner, subtle informative background, small icon, title "입력 내용을 확인하세요", body "필수 항목을 입력하면 저장할 수 있습니다.", quiet action "항목 확인". Under it one compact critical variant "저장하지 못했습니다" with "다시 시도". Keep readable contrast.
"Toast": a compact floating result message, title "링크를 복사했습니다", small success icon and close x. A second compact toast "문서를 보관했습니다" with a clear "되돌리기" action. Distinct from persistent Alert and not a stack of giant cards.

"SaveStatus": a thin editor footer sequence with four independent snapshots, labeled "변경됨", "저장 중", "저장됨", "저장 실패". Corresponding small neutral dot, spinner, check, error marker. boards.body:
